scripts.text:
[Jason]
The original pushcart is beautiful!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
原本的手推车真漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
The solid grey color pushcart.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
是那种纯灰色的手推车。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I can remodel it into new cute designs.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
我可以把它改造成可爱的新款式。

scripts.text: What is Pushcart Decoration?
scripts.translation: 什么是手推车装饰？

scripts.text: Learn Pushcart Decoration
scripts.translation: 学习手推车装饰

scripts.text: End Dialog
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I would like to completely remodel the poor pushcart.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
我想彻底改造一下那可怜的手推车。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
A little remodel isn't enough, don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
稍微改改是不够的，你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Therefore I have invented some new designs.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
所以我发明了一些新款式。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
It is cute and refreshing!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
既可爱又清爽！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Why do you want learn Pushcart Decoration? Don't disturb me!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
你想学手推车装饰？别打扰我！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
It is difficult to learn the Pushcart Decoration.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
学习手推车装饰很难的。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I will teach you if you bring the ^3131FFCute Cart Remodel Coupon^000000 to me.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
如果你把^3131FF可爱手推车改造券^000000带给我，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
You have brought the Cute Cart Remodel Coupon. Are you sure you want to learn Pushcart Decoration?
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
你带了可爱手推车改造券。你确定要学习手推车装饰吗？

scripts.text: YES
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: NO
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Come again after you have changed your mind!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
等你改变主意后再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Alright! Follow me.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
好吧！跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
This design
needs to catch the pushcart...
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
这个款式
需要固定住手推车...

scripts.text:
[Jason]
This design
needs to catch the pushcart.
Then add this....
...
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
这个款式
需要固定住手推车。
然后加上这个....
...

scripts.text:
[Jason]
You are a genius! You have learned it!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
你真是个天才！你已经学会了！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Now is your turn to do it.
Press Alt+S to change your pushcart!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
现在轮到你了。
按下Alt+S来改变你的手推车吧！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
This is the new cute design pushcart. You are one of our family now...!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
这就是新款的可爱手推车。你现在也是我们的一员了...！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Have you decorated the pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
你装饰好手推车了吗？

scripts.text: Is there more to learn?
scripts.translation: 还有别的要学的吗？

scripts.text: I forgot how to decorate my pushcart
scripts.translation: 我忘了怎么装饰手推车

scripts.text:
[Jason]
No. I am still exploring new designs. I will teach you once I have learned it.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
没有。我还在探索新的设计。等我学会了再教你。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I have something to teach, do you want to learn?
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
我有东西要教你，你想学吗？

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I need a ^3131FFCute Cart Remodel Coupon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
我需要一张^3131FF可爱手推车改造券^000000。

scripts.text: I want to learn
scripts.translation: 我想学

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Jason]
You can come back anytime.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
你随时都可以回来。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
You don't have any Cute Cart Remodel Coupon?
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
你没有可爱手推车改造券吗？

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Ok, let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
好，我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Doing it like this is better.
Do that like this as well...
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
这样做会更好。
也要这样做...

scripts.text:
[Jason]
....
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
....
让我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I have taught you the skill, you can try it now.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
我已经教你这个技能了，你现在可以试试。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Oh? Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
哦？让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Please come again after you can use the pushcart!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
请在你学会使用手推车后再来找我！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Do you not remember what I have taught you?
I have taught you this method.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
你不记得我教你的了吗？
我教过你这个方法。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
You have forgotten?
Let's recall now!
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
你忘了吗？
现在让我们回忆一下！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Think carefully, you will remember it again.
scripts.translation:
[杰森]
仔细想想，你肯定能想起来的。
